runtime_bridge_completion_not_fully_cons.summary: software-visible completions were not fully consumed before retirement

runtime_bridge_completion_queue_fault_si.summary: completion queue overflow fault snapshot did not match the frozen completion-overflow signature

runtime_bridge_completion_visibility_mis.summary: software-visible completion count was missing on a family that normally requires it

runtime_bridge_expected_fault_missing.summary: accepted fault did not reach the architectural runtime surface

runtime_bridge_fault_snapshot_missing.summary: fault count was non-zero but the visible fault CSR snapshot was missing

runtime_bridge_fault_snapshot_stale.summary: quiescent family retired with a stale non-zero fault snapshot

runtime_bridge_fused_step_completion_mis.summary: no fused-step completion progress was visible on the runtime bridge path

runtime_bridge_last_completion_nonzero.summary: quiescent family retired with a non-zero completion status

runtime_bridge_provider_unbound.summary: runtime_bridge provider binding was not visible

runtime_bridge_queue_fault_signature_mis.summary: queue backpressure fault snapshot did not match the frozen queue-overdoorbell signature

completion_consumed_covers_visible.summary: completion consumption should cover every visible completion unless the family intentionally stops earlier

completion_queue_fault_signature.summary: completion queue overflow family must expose the frozen aggregated cmpq-full fault snapshot

completion_visible.summary: software-visible completion count should normally be present on the runtime bridge path

fault_observed.summary: fault-reference families must surface at least one accepted fault

fault_snapshot_consistent.summary: fault snapshots must stay architecturally visible whenever fault_count is non-zero

fault_snapshot_quiescent.summary: quiescent families should not retire with a stale fault snapshot

fused_step_completion_visible.summary: fused-step completion or equivalent accepted-fault/barrier progress should be visible

last_completion_status_clean.summary: quiescent success families should retire with completion status 0

provider_bound_visible.summary: runtime_bridge provider binding must be visible before the family can PASS

queue_fault_signature.summary: queue backpressure family must expose the frozen aggregated cmdq-overdoorbell fault snapshot

barrier_wfi_order_ref.allowed_completion_signature: completion visibility alone may satisfy progress when barrier wakeup retires before software consumes the completion
barrier_wfi_order_ref.allowed_fault_signature: fault snapshot may remain zero or non-zero, but any observed fault must keep a visible snapshot

completion_queue_overflow_ref.allowed_completion_signature: one software-visible completion may remain intentionally unconsumed when cmpq-full fault retires

external_dyn_desc_bad_policy_ref.allowed_completion_signature: accepted-fault completion progress may satisfy the runtime bridge path even when committed progress is intentionally blocked
external_dyn_desc_bad_policy_ref.allowed_fault_signature: at least one accepted fault must remain architecturally visible

external_dyn_desc_fault_overwrite_chain_.allowed_completion_signature: accepted-fault completion progress is allowed while visible fault snapshots are overwritten across retired completions
external_dyn_desc_fault_overwrite_chain_.allowed_fault_signature: accepted faults may overwrite msnnfault after clear, but every observed fault must keep a visible snapshot

external_dyn_desc_fault_rearm_ref.allowed_completion_signature: accepted-fault completion progress is allowed while clear-then-refault lifecycle is visible
external_dyn_desc_fault_rearm_ref.allowed_fault_signature: accepted faults must reappear after msnnfault clear and remain architecturally visible

external_dyn_desc_fault_ref.allowed_completion_signature: accepted-fault completion progress counts as forward progress
external_dyn_desc_fault_ref.allowed_fault_signature: at least one accepted fault must remain architecturally visible

external_dyn_desc_ref.allowed_completion_signature: visible completions should be fully consumed and retire with status 0
external_dyn_desc_ref.allowed_fault_signature: fault_count should stay zero and last_fault_csr should remain zero

stat_snapshot_bad_selector_ref.allowed_completion_signature: bad-selector StatSnapshot retires through a visible fault snapshot and does not require a successful completion payload
stat_snapshot_bad_selector_ref.allowed_fault_signature: at least one bad-selector fault snapshot must remain architecturally visible

stat_snapshot_completed_ref.allowed_completion_signature: completed-count StatSnapshot should retire one visible completion carrying the completed-command snapshot payload
stat_snapshot_completed_ref.allowed_fault_signature: fault_count should stay zero and last_fault_csr should remain zero

stat_snapshot_provider_bound_ref.allowed_completion_signature: provider-bound StatSnapshot should retire one visible completion carrying the provider-bound snapshot payload
stat_snapshot_provider_bound_ref.allowed_fault_signature: fault_count should stay zero and last_fault_csr should remain zero

stat_snapshot_ref.allowed_completion_signature: accepted/basic StatSnapshot should retire one visible completion carrying the accepted-command snapshot payload
stat_snapshot_ref.allowed_fault_signature: fault_count should stay zero and last_fault_csr should remain zero

queue_backpressure_ref.allowed_completion_signature: command-overdoorbell overflow may fault before software acks the visible completion
